results.name: 1. Successful copy: everything copied, read back, identical; marker written; browser data untouched
1b. Second copy of the same data changes nothing (no new versions)
1c. One changed job becomes version 2; version 1 file is kept
2. Interrupted upload: failure reported, no marker, browser untouched; a rerun completes without duplicates
3. Bad fingerprint: a cloud file that does not match its fingerprint fails verification; no marker
3b. A record whose fingerprint differs from the browser job fails verification
4. Stale revision: another writer moves a record during the copy; copy stops, nothing overwritten, no marker
4b. Job changed by another computer before the copy: reported as a conflict, not overwritten, no marker
4c. Studio lock held by another computer: nothing is copied at all
4d. Job deleted in the cloud (tombstone): not brought back by a copy
5. Incomplete copy: a job silently skipped is caught by verification; no marker
5b. Verification alone detects a customer missing from the cloud
5c. Ids that cannot be stored are refused before anything is written
7. A failed attempt keeps the earlier marker, reports itself as failed, and the old marker does not verify the new browser state
6. Scale: 40 jobs, 2,000 panels, copied and verified
